Research Gap

What's Missing in Existing Systems

🔍 The Gap

While AI systems for skin disease detection have shown promising results, there is a significant gap in combining AI with Ayurvedic principles — especially Prakriti analysis. Existing solutions lack explainability, personalization, and remote accessibility. This research fills that gap by creating an AI-driven web application combining skin disease detection with Prakriti-based Ayurvedic advice.

⚠️ Problems

  • Ayurvedic medical knowledge is largely undigitalized and hard to integrate with modern AI
  • Most AI healthcare systems focus only on Western medicine and ignore Prakriti (body type)
  • People wanting personalized Ayurvedic treatment must physically visit practitioners

✅ Our Solution

  • AI-assisted web app combining skin disease identification and Prakriti analysis
  • Integrate Ayurvedic reasoning with modern deep learning techniques
  • Explainable insights and personalized lifestyle, diet, and home-care recommendations
Research Objectives

What We Aim to Achieve

1

Prakriti Identification

Automated body type detection using facial analysis and adaptive questionnaires.

2

Skin Disease Detection

CNN-based AI model with adaptive symptom questioning and confidence scoring.

3

Explainable Interpretation

Dual medical explanations from Western dermatology and Ayurvedic Dosha perspectives.

4

Personalized Guidance

Non-pharmacological lifestyle, dietary, and home-care recommendations by body type.

Methodology

How the System Works

1

User Input

User uploads facial photo and skin image, then completes an adaptive symptom questionnaire.

2

Prakriti Analysis

OpenCV + MediaPipe extract facial features combined with questionnaire via rule-based scoring.

3

Skin Disease AI

CNN classifies the skin image with adaptive follow-up questioning and confidence scoring.

4

Dual Interpretation

Results explained via Western dermatology and Ayurvedic Dosha concepts.

5

Personalized Output

Tailored diet, lifestyle, and home-care advice based on Prakriti type and skin condition.

6

Safety Safeguards

Red-flag symptoms trigger automatic medical referral. Outputs labeled as decision-support only.

🔬 Research Domain

Four novel modules combining AI, computer vision, and Ayurvedic medicine.

The Four Novelties

System Architecture & Modules

Novelty 01 — Hussainiya Hasan · IT22643636

🌿 Prakriti (Body Type) Identification Module

No existing digital system accurately identifies Ayurvedic Prakriti by combining facial feature analysis with adaptive questionnaires. This module extracts facial landmarks with OpenCV + MediaPipe and combines them with an adaptive questionnaire to classify users as Vata, Pitta, or Kapha with a confidence score.

OpenCVMediaPipeRule-Based ScoringAdaptive Questionnaire
Novelty 02 — Shenali Kumarathunga · IT22114976 (Group Leader)

🩺 Adaptive Skin Disease Identification Module

Most skin AI systems only use images and ignore symptoms and ethical safeguards. This module trains a CNN model on dermatology datasets, applies adaptive follow-up questioning to refine predictions, and triggers a medical referral when red-flag indicators are detected.

TensorFlowKerasCNNAdaptive QuestioningEthical Fail-Safe
Novelty 03 — Malinsa Methsiluni · IT22161024

📖 Explainable Dual-Medical Interpretation Module

Standard AI systems only output a disease label. This module provides dual explanations — Western dermatology rationale and Ayurvedic Dosha imbalance interpretation — both personalized to the user's Prakriti, driven by a JSON-based knowledge base.

Rule-Based LogicJSON Knowledge BaseXAI PrinciplesDosha Mapping
Novelty 04 — Warsha Herath · IT22081384

🥗 Prakriti-Aware Lifestyle, Diet & Home Care Module

Existing systems provide generic cosmetic recommendations. This module draws from classical Ayurvedic literature to generate non-pharmacological, ethically safe guidance — personalized dietary advice, lifestyle modifications, and natural skin care routines.

Ayurvedic LiteratureRule-Based RecommendationsNon-Pharmacological

Competitive Advantage

How We Compare

🤖

vs CNN-Only Systems

Standard CNN models classify from images alone. Our system adds Prakriti context, symptom questioning, explainability, and personalized guidance.

📋

vs Symptom Questionnaires

Symptom tools lack AI and visual analysis. Our adaptive approach dynamically adjusts questions combined with image-based AI for higher accuracy.

🌿

vs Traditional Ayurveda

Traditional diagnosis requires a physical visit. Our digital platform brings Prakriti-based personalization to anyone, anytime.
